Growth Marketer – Part‑Time (Grow Into Head of Marketing)

Join to apply for the Growth Marketer In Global Running Company – Part-Time With Room To Grow Into Head Of Marketing role at Go! Running Tours

3 days ago Be among the first 25 applicants

Join to apply for the Growth Marketer In Global Running Company – Part-Time With Room To Grow Into Head Of Marketing role at Go! Running Tours

Hi… My name is Lena, and I am the founder of Go! Running Tours. This is not your usual job post. Instead of writing a fast‑paced, bullet‑pointed post with the words driven, team player, high performer, etc., I thought I would give it a go at simply writing the good, the bad, and the ugly about being a Growth Marketer with Go! Running Tours. Maybe no one will reply. Maybe many will. I just need one really good one! So let’s start. Our new Growth Marketer will be responsible for all our marketing activities for B2C and B2B clients.

Our current markets are growing (some by 100+%) and we are constantly looking for new channels and markets to sell our services. Your marketing DNA has to be of the rare kind that is analytical and structured, while also having the creativity to craft great copy, see new opportunities, and connect the dots between B2C and B2B. I am looking for a colleague who works systematically with new ideas and markets, has attention to detail, and gets super excited about the responsibility you are given and the fact that the world is your marketing playground. We are lucky that sometimes amazing opportunities (that – if you are a runner and marketeer – probably will make you do cartwheels) land in our turban.

You’ll be working on a newsletter and pling! An email lands in your inbox from Brooks, or Lululemon, or Abbott World Marathon Majors. Other times, results come from your structured and clever efforts over time. It’s not because we got it right the first time, but because we kept on researching, learning, testing and voilà: now you nailed it! Our clients include US Bank, Goldman Sachs, Amex, Google, Accenture and runners of equal awesomeness from all over the world! We also work with some of the biggest names in the running industry (NDA signed) and in the future, with your help, many more…right?

I am looking for someone in constant growth mode. Growth in terms of always looking for new opportunities to grow the business. Growth in terms of testing an initiative in one city and then scaling it to the rest of our destinations. Growth in terms of taking the time to research new tech, new ways of doing things, and current trends. Email marketing is a strong channel of ours, and if you get a thrill from optimising flows, building smart automations, and digging into data to make things work better and smarter, then this is your playground. We already send regular newsletters that do well, BUT someone with a data/automation mindset who puts their Sherlock Holmes hat on will, without a doubt, be able to optimise this tremendously. And have loads of fun with it.

I personally love testing new ideas, so know that you'll have me and colleagues from all over the world cheering you on every step of the way. You’ll also own our digital advertising efforts. That means planning and running campaigns on Meta and Google, exploring new platforms, and keeping an eye on what actually moves the needle. We don't throw spaghetti at the wall here: we test, learn, and scale what works. You'll also get to create clever case studies, explore sponsorship opportunities, and pitch bold ideas that help us reach new runners, new companies, and new destinations. If you spot a gap, we want you to fill it (and we'll back you while you do). You will be working directly with me in the role.

I love my job, and every day I am utterly grateful that I work in a company with a concept that “makes sense” to me, and with colleagues who are skilled, helpful, and positive. I love running, and I have the pleasure of working with runners from all over the world and together, we cater for the best customer group in the world: runners! Some people may find me difficult to work with, as I am impatient, I focus radically on progress, and I dislike sloppiness (with a passion). Most people, I believe (or at least hope), also find me kind, fun, optimistic, trusting, and understanding (admittedly still very little understanding for sloppiness ;-)). My guess is that if you are good at what you do and eager to excel in this role, we will end up best buddies!

We work remotely and have only 2–3 hours of internal meetings a week. All other time is reserved for deep work and basically getting things done. There is always time for a call, and we are all on Slack, so you're never left alone in any way. We're just on the other side of the world.

The salary is not one that will secure you a Ferrari or a holiday to Mauritius (at least not to begin with). It is a salary that should be comfortable and is based on reduced working hours, so you can have a fun and fulfilling life besides work. The Money Should Not Be The Main Motivation For You – Running, Bridging Cultures, And Being Part Of a Fun, Fast-moving, And Positive Company Should. The Contract Details Are As Follows: USD 1,400 a month, 25 hrs a week, Managed via Upwork. Oh, and hey… if you're considering this role as an add-on to an already existing full‑time job, then hold your horses. I don't believe in my colleagues working 60+ hours a week, and it simply doesn't align with our company values. We want you to have the energy, focus, and headspace to do great work and enjoy life outside of it. The most important traits to bring to the role are being a fast mover, a super collaborator, and having a drive to grow… the business and yourself. But the most important skill of all is: execution. If we don't execute, we can't move the needle. That’s it, I think. I've probably left out loads of super important things, but at least this gives you some idea. If you feel this role could be for you, then please write to me with a short spiel on why you feel you're right for the role and why you would like to work at Go! Running Tours (no AI please - we want to know the real you, not the ChatGPT version ). Thanks for reading this far, Lena

Note: we usually take down our job posts within 3-4 days as we receive many applicants.

title: Senior Software Engineer
description:
Teachable

is a no-code platform for creators who want to build a more impactful business through courses, coaching, downloadable content, and community. With Teachable, creators can engage their online audiences and get paid—on their own terms. Today, tens of thousands of creators use Teachable to share their knowledge and, to date, have reached more than 46 million students around the world.

Are you ready to join a dynamic, cross-cultural team at an exciting turning point in our company’s journey? Now part of the global

Hotmart Company

portfolio, Teachable continues to take the creator economy by storm as a true industry leader. Together, Teachable and Hotmart are delivering market-leading products that prioritize creator control and flexibility, alongside meaningful partnership and support from our team. If you have big ideas, relish the chance to challenge convention, and deeply believe in the power of creators to shape the future, we want you on our team!

What is the role? We are looking for a senior engineer with backend experience, who will join our team mainly focused on backend development, always focusing on delivering applications for high traffic access, well-monitored and fully tested. You will be responsible for the entire development lifecycle. In our team, everyone has the opportunity to share ideas, bring new solutions, and discuss them with other well-experienced engineers.

In this role you’ll :

  • Write secure, efficient, and high-quality code that adheres to best practices, such as encryption of sensitive data and input validation.
  • Develop scalable and reusable code that promotes efficient development, such as creating reusable libraries and components.
  • Identify areas for improvement in the codebase and take ownership of small-to-medium-sized systems, such as fixing bugs and optimizing performance.
  • Quickly understand documentation and utilize testing techniques, such as unit testing, integration testing, and stress testing, to ensure high-quality code.
  • Communicate effectively with team members and stakeholders, such as providing regular status updates and actively seeking feedback.
  • Adapt to roadblocks and proactively resolve issues, such as debugging and troubleshooting.
  • Align work with customer value by using feedback to prioritize features.
  • Balance priorities and seek guidance when needed to make informed decisions.

What You’ll Bring :

  • 3+ years of hands‑on experience building production web applications in an agile, startup environment.
  • Experience migrating domains from monolithic to microservices.
  • Experience working with systems at scale utilizing microservices, AWS services.
  • Interest in learning or exposure to event‑based architecture.
  • Team player mentality: high collaborative, documentation‑focused and recognizing how to balance asynchronous communications and virtual meetings.
  • A passion for solving complex technical problems in both new and legacy codebases.
  • A mindset of leaving the codebase better than how you found it.
  • Experience collaborating with multiple team members with varying experience levels to design and implement technical projects.
  • Ability to work and problem‑solve independently.
  • A humble, collaborative, customer‑focused, and highly curious approach to problem‑solving.

Nice to have :

  • Golang experience

This is a CLT contract with full benefits, paid in $BRL.

Assistente de Gerente - Boca do Rio | Farmácias Pague Menos

Somos gente que cuida de gente. Cada um com características, histórias e qualidades únicas, mas todos unidos pelo mesmo propósito: viver plenamente. Temos orgulho da nossa história, por isso fazemos o nosso melhor hoje, sem deixar de olhar para o amanhã. Se você preza pela valorização humana, integridade, foco no cliente, superação de resultados, sustentabilidade, inovação em soluções em tudo o que faz, vem fazer parte do nosso time de gigantes.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Acompanhar os processos da loja;
  • Realizar um acompanhamento diário junto aos caixas e ou operador de loja, observando o preenchimento de formulários, agilizando o atendimento ao cliente e auxiliando a equipe nas horas de maior fluxo na farmácia;

  • Responsável pela parte financeira da farmácia tais como: troca, devolução, cancelados e cartões;

  • Responsável pelo recebimento do carro forte;
  • Realizar as erratas mensais com mudança de preço;
  • Conferir os valores dispensados pelos caixas em dinheiro (sangrias);
  • Complementar os caixas com trocos (moedas ou cédulas), conforme suas necessidades;
  • Assumir a gerência na ausência do Gerente de Loja.

Requisitos e qualificações

  • Cursando graduação em farmácia;
  • Conhecimento em informática;
  • Experiência em liderar equipes e organizar processos administrativos;
  • Experiência com vendas e atendimento ao cliente.

Benefícios

  • Vale-refeição (de acordo com a convenção coletiva);
  • Vale-transporte;
  • Plano de Saúde por elegibilidade por localidade e cargo;
  • Plano Odontológico por adesão;
  • Seguro de vida e Assistência Funeral;
  • Plataforma de terapia online;
  • Programa de Gestantes;
  • Convênios Educacionais com descontos exclusivos para colaboradores e dependentes;
  • Universidade Corporativa Pague Menos com cursos e treinamentos - Up Farma;
  • Desconto Ouro nas Farmácias Pague Menos;
  • Convênio Farmácia, com desconto em folha de pagamento - Epharma.

Não fazemos distinção de cor, religião, orientação sexual, identidade de gênero, nacionalidade, deficiência ou idade.

Na história da Rede de Farmácias Pague Menos e Extrafarma, saúde e bem-estar são origem, mas também propósito. Para nós, promover o acesso à saúde significa liberdade e dignidade. Somos uma empresa brasileira, feita de gente apaixonada por gente. Estamos presente em todos os estados do país, por isso, somos gigantes e diversos por natureza! Nossa história começou em 1981, quando inauguramos nossa primeira loja em Fortaleza-CE e por meio da valorização humana, da superação de resultados, do foco no cliente, da sustentabilidade, da integridade e da inovação em soluções nos tornamos a segunda maior rede de farmácias do Brasil. Nosso modelo de negócios é baseado na venda de produtos e serviços voltados para a saúde e bem-estar dos nossos clientes. Atuamos no mercado de varejo de especialidade, seguindo o conceito de drugstore. Buscamos ser não somente uma rede de farmácias, mas um hub integrado de saúde. Desta forma, implementamos, a partir de 2016, o Clinic Farma, consultório farmacêutico o qual nossos clientes recebem, em salas equipadas e confortáveis, acompanhamento individualizado em seus tratamentos. Hoje, somos mais de 25 mil gigantes unidos por um mesmo propósito: assegurar acesso a uma saúde de qualidade no Brasil para que mais pessoas vivam plenamente. Se você tem amor por servir e é gente que cuida de gente, vem ser Gigante! Aqui, quem acredita e trabalha cresce.

You’ll love working here because you can: collaborate. Courage comes from how associates are willing to have difficult conversations, speak up, be an owner, and respect one another’s ideas to find the best solution.

description:
About Revolut

People deserve more from their money. More visibility, more control, and more freedom. Since 2015, Revolut has been on a mission to deliver just that. Our powerhouse of products — including spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more — help our 65+ million customers get more from their money every day.

As we continue our lightning-fast growth, 2 things are essential to our success : our people and our culture. In recognition of our outstanding employee experience, we've been certified as a Great Place to Work™. So far, we have 10,000+ people working around the world, from our offices and remotely, to help us achieve our mission. And we're looking for more brilliant people. People who love building great products, redefining success, and turning the complexity of a chaotic world into the simplicity of a beautiful solution.

About the role

Our Financial Crime team blends regulatory expertise with data-driven thinking to make sure our products meet legal and policy requirements and deliver real value to customers. In a fast-moving, digital environment, they stay one step ahead by finding smart, scalable ways to prevent financial crime.

We're looking for a Fraud Risk Manager to reinforce our first line of defence (1LoD) FinCrime framework in Brazil and focus on fraud prevention.

You’ll act as the core fraud risk expert, bringing your senior expertise to secure our operations and design, implement, and oversee effective fraud controls across key local products.

Up to shape what’s next in finance? Let’s get in touch.

What you'll be doing

Designing and enhancing fraud prevention controls within Brazil’s 1LoD framework, ensuring alignment with local BCB regulatory expectations and license requirements

Performing detailed fraud risk assessments across products (PIX, credit, cards, and business accounts), identifying control gaps and recommending practical mitigations

Leading the development and implementation of fraud prevention strategies, including creating and tuning transaction monitoring rules, leveraging data-driven models, and defining robust response workflows

Overseeing major fraud incidents and investigations, supporting containment, recovery, and required regulatory reporting processes

Partnering closely with Product and Data Science teams to improve automation, detection efficiency, and case triage logic, challenging the status quo for continuous improvement

Monitoring and analysing fraud trends and key performance indicators (KPIs) to produce actionable insights and dashboards for local management and committees

Strengthening fraud governance, ensuring clear documentation of risks, controls, and residual exposures to demonstrate control maturity during regulatory engagements

What you'll need

5+ years of experience in fraud risk management, prevention, detection, or Investigations within a financial institution or fintech

A deep understanding of fraud typologies, detection models, and control frameworks across payment and credit products (PIX, cards, credit)

Solid knowledge of local (BCB) FinCrime and fraud regulations and reporting obligations

Hands‑on experience creating, tuning, and validating fraud detection rules and working with model performance metrics

Experience leading complex investigations end‑to‑end, identifying control weaknesses, and proposing remediation

The ability to navigate ambiguity, connect data to risk impact, and design pragmatic, scalable solutions

A proven ability to partner with Product, Data Science, and Compliance teams to implement risk controls effectively

Great communication skills to relay complex fraud and regulatory topics clearly to both technical and non‑technical audiences

Nice to have

Proficiency in using analytical tools (e.g., SQL, Python, Looker)

Confidence in presenting risk insights, fraud trends, and remediation updates

An interest in developing junior team members as the function scales

  • Only apply through official Revolut channels. We don’t use any third‑party services or platforms for our recruitment.

We won't ask for payment or personal financial information during the hiring process. If anyone does ask you for this, it’s a scam. Report it immediately.

Client's Profile

Founded in New Jersey in 1997, this award-winning luxury salon and wellness spa is more than a destination for beauty; it's a space for transformation, self-expression, and connection. As the Operations Manager, this role is not a traditional operations assistant role, and it's not suited for a traditional candidate. The client is building more than a business. They are nurturing a vision of trust, growth, and collaborative improvement. As the Operations Manager, you are the trusted partner who supports the founder from behind the scenes, with clear systems, executive presence, and emotional intelligence. You'll facilitate team meetings, track KPIs, manage tools like Zenoti and Shopify, coordinate marketing tasks, and keep the founder's priorities aligned. This hands‑on role is ideal for someone who thrives in structure, demonstrates initiative, and prioritizes clarity and detail.

Operations & Integrator Coordination : 60% Role Allocation

Team & Operations Management – Be the primary support to the Founder in managing day‑to‑day operations and overall team integration. Be the point of contact for internal issues and help with swift resolution. Help create and implement organizational strategies that support company goals. Lead planning sessions, team meetings, and 1 : 1s; take notes and follow up on action items. Manage projects from start to finish, including timelines, budgets, and delivery. Track team KPIs and tasks, offering support where needed. Prepare reports on Operations and Team Performance for the Founder. Identify ways to improve processes and communication, applying emotional intelligence in communication dynamics. Create and maintain an easy‑to‑follow Operations Playbook.

System Management & Process Oversight – Manage internal tools like Zenoti and Qnity, including employee logs, credentials, client scheduling, cancellations, promo campaigns, etc. Oversee inventory and updates in Zenoti and Shopify, ensuring stock is correct and within budget. Review reports and workflows to find and fix inefficiencies.

Marketing & Content Coordination : 25% Role Allocation

Marketing Coordination – Coordinate marketing tasks across departments to keep campaigns on track. Oversee the submission and of marketing materials, advertisements, and promotions within Zenoti and Shopify.

Content Curation & Social Media Management – Support social media efforts by duplicating and scheduling content (IG, FB, LinkedIn, Google) to align with business initiatives. Write simple copy, quotes, or weekly updates as needed, ensuring consistent brand tone. Monitor engagement and share relevant content ideas as needed.

Strategic Founder & Client Support : 10% Role Allocation

Own the Founder's calendar, meetings, and priorities; give daily updates. Keep the Founder's email inbox organized, respond to messages, and track follow‑ups. Turn the Founder's ideas (notes or voice memos) into actionable tasks. Protect the Founder's time while supporting the team and aligning priorities. Communicate with clients as needed, handling urgent escalations, urgent follow‑ups and building relationships.

What You Should Have Must-haves

At least seven years of experience in Executive Support, Operations, or Integrator roles, ideally supporting C‑level or Founder Executives. Experience supporting a Founder or Executive in a Salon, Spa, Aesthetic, or Wellness brand, particularly in fast‑paced, multi‑business environments. At least one year of experience in a global remote or virtual environment for a company or with clients in North America, Europe, Australia, or the UAE. Strong integrator and operational management skills, with the ability to translate high‑level strategies into actionable plans and workflows. Mastery of English communication skills, both written and verbal, with a professional tone and neutral accent for both internal coordination and client correspondence. Proven ability to manage multiple workstreams, coordinate with cross‑functional teams, and manage day‑to‑day operations. Client‑facing experience, with the ability to handle escalations professionally and maintain relationships. Hands‑on experience with Zenoti (or similar scheduling / inventory systems) and Shopify for backend coordination and updates. Experience in light copywriting, editing, and scheduling social media content across IG, Facebook, LinkedIn, and Google platforms. Proficient in remote office tools like Google Workspace (Docs, Sheets, Drive, Calendar) and Slack (or Teams). Experience with project management tools like Asana, Notion, or ClickUp. Proven experience supporting internal operations, maintaining trackers and summary reports (e.g., logins, performance, promos). Exposure to process optimization frameworks, with the ability to implement improvements and create SOPs from scratch. Ability to work independently, take initiative without close supervision, and keep executives focused on what matters most.

Technology Specifications

Minimum 100 Mbps Internet Speed Windows 11 or macOS 15 Sequoia Minimum Intel i5 8th gen with 8GB RAM or Apple M1 chip with 8GB RAM Webcam and Headset Designated Quiet Office Space

Nice‑to‑haves

Experience with the Entrepreneurial Operating System (EOS) framework, including L10 meetings, Rocks, Scorecards, and IDS. Basic design knowledge for editing branded visual assets in Canva.

Who You Are

We are hoping you are someone who : Naturally steps in to solve problems, keep things moving, and stays a few steps ahead. Thinks clearly and critically, great at untangling complex challenges, spotting what's not working, and helping build smoother systems. Communicates with clarity and confidence, whether giving a quick update to the team or coordinating with external partners, you know how to get the message across with emotional intelligence. About the Role

We are seeking an experienced Base24 / Base24 Classic Developer to support payment switch development, enhancement, and operational stability within a high-volume card transaction environment. The ideal candidate has hands‑on experience working with Tandem / HP NonStop systems, Base24 modules, issuer / acquirer interfaces, and ATM / POS transaction processing flows. This role requires strong technical depth in transaction message processing (ISO 8583) , ATM / POS terminal driving, and tuning systems for high availability and performance. The developer will work closely with cross‑functional teams including Product, Application Support, Network Security, and Environment Infrastructure.

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop, configure, enhance, and support Base24 / Base24 Classic applications on HP NonStop (Tandem) platform.
  • Maintain and modify ATM / POS transaction switch modules, authorization, settlement, and device handler components.
  • Monitor and troubleshoot end‑to‑end transaction flows including issuer / acquirer interfaces.
  • Analyze and resolve production issues with strong ownership of incident / problem resolution.
  • Implement code enhancements, patches, and release changes in alignment with governance and compliance standards.
  • Design and execute system integration testing, regression testing, and certification testing with network partners (Visa / MasterCard).
  • Work with cross‑functional teams to support performance tuning, batch processing, and environment stability.
  • Ensure secure, compliant, and resilient handling of financial transaction data.
  • Prepare and maintain detailed technical documentation, release notes, and operational runbooks.

Required Skills & Experience

  • 5+ years hands‑on experience with Base24 or Base24 Classic.
  • Strong technical expertise in HP NonStop / Tandem (Guardian, OSS) Pathway, TAL, COBOL, SCOBOL, C, TACL, DDL, SQL / Enscribe ATM and POS network protocols, ISO 8583 message formats.
  • Experience supporting high‑availability, transaction‑intensive payment switching platforms.
  • Hands‑on experience in debugging, log analysis, and performance tuning in a production environment.
  • Knowledge of Visa / MasterCard authorization and clearing, card bin tables, key exchange, PIN translation.
  • Experience in incident management, change control, and release management.

Good to Have

  • Exposure to Base24‑eps migration or development.
  • Experience working with Fiserv, First Data, TSYS, ACI Postilion, or Opus environments.
  • Knowledge of EMV, HSM (Thales / SafeNet), cryptographic key management.
  • Experience with Jira, Confluence, Git, and CI/CD toolchains.

Education

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or related field (or equivalent work experience).

Department: Customer & Professional Services

About us

Graphic Communications, a CAI Division, is a leading global provider of industry-specific business and production software technology for the print industry. Graphic Communications’ integrated and automated offerings and point solutions are designed to enable revenue growth and drive operating and production efficiencies. With over thirty years dedicated to delivering best‑in‑class technology to the packaging and printing industries, it is the company’s deeply held philosophy that they succeed when its customers thrive.

Position Overview

The Resource Manager plays a critical role in ensuring Professional Services teams are properly staffed, aligned, and equipped to meet project timelines and business objectives. This role involves close collaboration with Project Managers, Project Coordinators, Regional Managers, the Sr. Director of Professional Services, Customer Success, and Sales to efficiently manage resources, balance workloads, and ensure smooth project delivery.

Responsibilities

Resource Planning and Allocation

  • Identify, assign, and allocate resources to ongoing and upcoming projects based on skills, availability, and priorities.
  • Maintain a real-time view of resource capacity and project needs across the organization.
  • Serve as the primary point of contact for project staffing and collaborate with Sales and Regional Managers to ensure proper coverage for upcoming engagements.
  • Own all new engagements at intake and assign resources based on availability and skillset.
  • Check in regularly with Project Managers to confirm they have the resources required for project success.
  • Maintain up-to-date skills and certifications records for all consultants.

Forecasting and Talent Management

  • Collaborate with Sales, Project Managers, Regional Managers, and leadership to forecast future resource requirements.
  • Identify resource gaps and recommend cross-training, recruitment, or subcontracting needs based on upcoming opportunities.
  • Support long-term workforce planning and professional development of consultants.

Process Optimization and Tool Management

  • Develop and maintain tools, dashboards, and reports to monitor utilization, productivity, and performance.
  • Establish and enforce consistent processes for resource requests and assignments to maximize efficiency.
  • Ensure data and processes remain aligned across systems.

Daily Operational Responsibilities

New Engagement Intake

  • Review new projects pushed from Salesforce into Wrike.
  • Confirm all project metadata: customer, region, product, estimated hours, and key contacts.
  • Confirm the correct Wrike template and folder structure were created.
  • If automation fails, manually create projects using Salesforce data.

Assignment & Scheduling

  • Review unassigned Wrike projects daily.
  • Match consultants to projects based on skill set, availability, and regional needs.
  • Assign both primary and secondary consultants and confirm schedules with stakeholders.
  • Flag any assignment conflicts or delays to Regional Managers or Services Leads.

System Sync and Integration Oversight

  • Cross-reference Salesforce → Wrike and Wrike → NetSuite mappings to ensure accuracy.
  • Validate billing fields (sold‑to ID, billing trigger, engagement type) and confirm correct syncing.
  • Ensure Concur sync processes are updating users, vendors, and expenses accurately.
  • Monitor Wrike integration logs and elevate issues as needed.
  • Maintain field mapping and oversee sync processes across Salesforce, NetSuite, and Concur.
  • Track and resolve open integration issues in collaboration with Operations.

Time Tracking Oversight

  • Validate daily timesheet entries for all consultants.
  • Identify missing, misallocated, or excessive time entries and follow up as needed.
  • Escalate persistent noncompliance to Regional Managers.
  • Ensure adherence to time entry policies for accurate utilization and billing reporting.

Project Health & Status Monitoring

  • Monitor project dashboards in Wrike for task completion, budget consumption, and forecasted effort.

Reporting & Communication

  • Participate in regular syncs with Regional Managers.
  • Track upcoming projects, resourcing constraints, and urgent escalations.
  • Respond to inquiries regarding capacity, project swaps, or timeline adjustments.
  • Provide data for utilization, staffing, revenue forecasting, and any other Professional Services metrics.

Performance and Collaboration

  • Monitor workload balance across consultants.
  • Participate in resource reviews with Regional Managers to support continuous development based on Sales forecast.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with Sales, Customer Success, and Professional Services teams to align timelines, priorities, and dependencies.

Qualifications

Experience

  • 4+ years of experience in resource planning or operations within a software or technology organization.
  • Proven ability to manage multiple concurrent projects and balance resources effectively in a fast-paced environment.

Skills

  • Strong proficiency with resource planning tools (e.g., Wrike)
  • Working knowledge of JIRA, Salesforce, required, and NetSuite preferred.
  • Excellent organizational, communication, and negotiation skills.

AgileEngine is an Inc. 5000 company that creates award-winning software for Fortune 500 brands and trailblazing startups across 17+ industries. We rank among the leaders in areas like application development and AI / ML, and our people‑first culture has earned us multiple Best Place to Work awards.

Why Join Us

If you’re looking for a place to grow, make an impact, and work with people who care, we’d love to meet you!

About the Role

We are looking for a Sales Engineering Delivery Manager with 3+ years of experience to connect prospective clients and internal teams. You will lead discovery sessions, capture key details like timelines and budgets, and turn insights into clear, high‑impact proposals. Strong knowledge of business strategy, the SDLC, and excellent communication skills are essential.

What You Will Do

Technical Discovery Call & Stakeholder Engagement

  • Assemble Sales Support Engineering team, align them on preliminary information, following internal RACI procedures;
  • Lead the Technical Discovery call, showcasing outstanding interpersonal skills with the ability to build rapport and trust quickly;
  • Demonstrate in-depth knowledge of the SDLC—from ideation and inception, through discovery and development, to market release—to guide discussions and identify project feasibility;
  • Use consultative questioning techniques to uncover client pain points and business objectives, extracting and analyzing high‑level requirements such as project timeline, budget constraints, technical skill requirements, and risk assessments;
  • Showcase strong presentation and storytelling skills, ensuring clarity and persuasion in all client‑facing interactions, both during calls and via emails.

Proposal Development & Deliverable Creation

  • Develop dynamic, visually compelling presentation decks and engagement proposals that clearly articulate service offerings, project scope, value propositions, and strategic recommendations;
  • Customize deliverables to reflect client‑specific challenges and opportunities uncovered during discovery meetings;
  • Integrate technical insights with business strategy, ensuring that proposals account for both immediate deliverables and long‑term client growth.

Team Buildout and Project Kickoff

  • Act as the primary point of coordination among Sales, Recruiting, and Engineering teams, ensuring smooth hand‑offs from initial engagement through team buildout to project kick‑off;
  • Serve as a “concierge” for deals, maintaining fluid communication and alignment across functions to drive successful client onboarding;
  • Serve as a trusted advisor during pre‑sales engagements by translating complex technical aspects into digestible, business‑focused narratives;
  • Maintain a sales / consulting mindset throughout the technical discovery process, ensuring proposals align with targeted business outcomes.

MUST HAVES

  • 3+ years of experience in similar Sales & Delivery Management roles;
  • Exceptional Communication & Soft Skills: outstanding interpersonal skills with the ability to build rapport and trust quickly; strong presentation and storytelling skills, ensuring clarity and persuasion in all client‑facing interactions;
  • UX & Presentation Design Acumen: solid grasp of user experience (UX) principles and design thinking, enabling effective discussion of digital product experiences; proven track record of creating high‑quality, visually engaging presentation decks and proposals;
  • Technical Savvy & SDLC Knowledge: a deep understanding of the software development lifecycle—from conceptualization through to market release—and familiarity with agile methodologies; capability to discuss technical nuances without losing sight of the business impact, bridging the gap between technical details and strategic outcomes;
  • Analytical & Strategic Thinking: strong analytical skills to synthesize complex information, identify key insights, and recommend actionable strategies; ability to prioritize client objectives while balancing technical feasibility and business goals;
  • Team Collaboration & Cross‑Functional Coordination: demonstrated ability to work effectively across multiple departments, managing internal communications as deals move from the funnel stage to the kickoff; capability to serve as a liaison, ensuring alignment and clarity among Sales, Engineering, and Recruiting teams;
  • Consultative Sales Experience: prior experience in a pre‑sales, sales engineering, or technical consulting role, ideally within a digital software consultancy or similar environment; ability to quickly assess client needs and transform them into actionable insights and proposals.

Perks and Benefits

  • Professional growth: Accelerate your professional journey with mentorship, TechTalks, and personalized growth roadmaps.
  • Competitive compensation: We match your ever‑growing skills, talent, and contributions with competitive USD‑based compensation and budgets for education, fitness, and team activities.
  • A selection of exciting projects: Join projects with modern solutions development and top‑tier clients that include Fortune 500 enterprises and leading product brands.
  • Flextime: Tailor your schedule for an optimal work‑life balance, by having the options of working from home and going to the office – whatever makes you the happiest and most productive.

Requirements

3+ years of experience in similar Sales & Delivery Management roles. Outstanding interpersonal skills with the ability to build rapport and trust quickly. Strong presentation and storytelling skills, ensuring clarity and persuasion in all client‑facing interactions. Solid grasp of user experience (UX) principles and design thinking, enabling effective discussion of digital product experiences. Proven track record of creating high‑quality, visually engaging presentation decks and proposals. A deep understanding of the software development lifecycle—from conceptualization through to market release—and familiarity with agile methodologies. Capability to discuss technical nuances without losing sight of the business impact, bridging the gap between technical details and strategic outcomes. Strong analytical skills to synthesize complex information, identify key insights, and recommend actionable strategies. Ability to prioritize client objectives while balancing technical feasibility and business goals. Demonstrated ability to work effectively across multiple departments, managing internal communications as deals move from the funnel stage to the kickoff. Capability to serve as a liaison, ensuring alignment and clarity among Sales, Engineering, and Recruiting teams. Prior experience in a pre‑sales, sales engineering, or technical consulting role, ideally within a digital software consultancy or similar environment. Ability to quickly assess client needs and transform them into actionable insights and proposals.

Fundada em 1996, a Petrobahia foi uma das primeiras distribuidoras regionais a entrar em operação no país, se tornando sinônimo de empreendedorismo na nova fase que se iniciou no setor de combustíveis. Nessa época, os fundadores da empresa já atuavam na área - com uma rede de postos e uma das mais conceituadas transportadoras do mercado - e decidiram que era hora de uma nova e desafiadora empreitada: formar uma distribuidora de combustível regional com características muito específicas. A ideia, que logo se concretizou, foi atuar junto a pequenas cidades, que não possuíam postos, e em locais não assistidos pelas distribuidoras multinacionais, atendendo de perto às necessidades de cada cliente.

Todo o trabalho foi desenvolvido com muito planejamento e seriedade, logo tornando a Petrobahia reconhecida por duas importantes características: a solidez e a credibilidade. Hoje, a empresa continua aberta à inovação e atenta às oportunidades de mercado, contando com números expressivos: são 06 bases de operações e uma rede com cerca de 70 postos revendedores espalhados entre Bahia, Sergipe, Minas Gerais, Piauí e Pernambuco. Além disso, a companhia ainda possui cerca de 1000 clientes ativos, distribuídos entre grandes consumidores e postos bandeira branca. São resultados diretamente ligados ao trabalho de uma equipe amplamente preparada e à manutenção de uma relação forte e fidelizada com nossos clientes. Uma história de sucesso escrita a cada dia e movida a cada novo desafio.

Nossa estrutura

Nossos terminais estão entre os mais tecnológicos do País e atendem aos mais rigorosos estandartes de qualidade de todas as regiões onde atuamos e onde nossas bases estão distribuídas: Nordeste, Centro-Oeste, Norte e Sudeste.

Possuímos estrutura para cessão de espaço a congênere e uma Central de Relacionamento criada para melhor atender o cliente, com integração de todos os setores da Companhia e rápida capacidade de retorno.

Possuímos unidades em várias macrorregiões baianas e em outros estados, o que nos permite atender cidades espalhadas por diferentes polos e regiões.

title: Principal Consultant – SOC Transformation and XSIAM Deployment
description:
Our Mission

At Palo Alto Networks® everything starts and ends with our mission :

Being the cybersecurity partner of choice, protecting our digital way of life.

Our vision is a world where each day is safer and more secure than the one before. We are a company built on the foundation of challenging and disrupting the way things are done, and we’re looking for innovators who are as committed to shaping the future of cybersecurity as we are.

Who We Are

This role is remote, but distance is no barrier to impact. Our hybrid teams collaborate across geographies to solve big problems, stay close to our customers, and grow together. You will be part of a culture that values trust, accountability, and shared success where your work truly matters.

Your Career

As a Principal Consultant for SOC Transformation & XSIAM Deployment, you will be a seasoned leader at the forefront of our most strategic customer engagements. You will leverage a rare blend of consultative presence, deep technical mastery, and executive influence to guide our customers through complex SOC transformations. Your primary role is to drive these large-scale programs, ensuring the successful execution of foundational elements like seamless log migration and the development of sophisticated detection strategies, to deliver measurable security outcomes in highly dynamic enterprise environments.

Your Impact

  • Serve as the lead strategic advisor and subject matter expert for customers undertaking a full‑scale SOC modernization with XSIAM
  • Lead multi‑national SOC transformation programs, consolidating fragmented detection and response processes into a unified, AI‑driven platform
  • Direct enterprise‑scale XSIAM deployments, guiding customers from initial strategy to full operationalization
  • Devise and oversee comprehensive log ingestion strategies to ensure high‑quality data fuels the XSIAM platform
  • Architect and implement sophisticated detection strategies and correlation rules to fortify customer defenses against advanced threats
  • Fine‑tune and optimize log sources and correlation rules to maximize system performance and detection efficacy
  • Identify opportunities to enhance analyst alert handling and response through automation
  • Transform ambiguity into structured action plans, driving accountability at every level of a customer engagement
  • Build and mentor high‑performing professional services teams that blend consulting, engineering, and change management expertise
  • Partner with Product and R&D teams to incorporate field insights into roadmap priorities

Qualifications

A proven track record in modernizing Security Operations Centers (SOCs) to achieve automation, AI‑driven detection, and measurable improvements in MTTD / MTTR

Your Experience

  • Exceptional executive presence, with strong verbal and written communication skills to engage with stakeholders from the SOC analyst to the CISO
  • Experience acting as a trusted advisor to senior security leaders, with the ability to diagnose challenges and deliver strategic recommendations
  • 10+ years of hands‑on experience in deploying and integrating SIEM / security analytics solutions within large enterprise environments
  • 8+ years of experience with Security Operations Center (SOC) tooling, processes, and workflows
  • Hands‑on technical mastery across SIEM, SOAR, EDR, cloud security, and threat intelligence
  • Ability to conceive, architect, and develop effective correlation and detection rules
  • Familiarity with a range of SIEM technologies, such as Splunk and IBM QRadar, is a plus

Strong expertise in Regular Expressions (Regex)

  • Relevant bachelor's degree or industry‑recognized qualifications (CISSP, GIAC, etc.), is a plus.
  • PreSales is a Plus
  • 30% Travel

Additional Information

Our Professional Services team is critical to our success and mission. As part of this team, you enable customer success by providing support to clients post‑sale. Our dedication to our customers doesn’t stop once they sign — it evolves. As threats and technology evolve, we stay in step to accomplish our mission. You’ll be involved in implementing new products, transitioning from old products to new, and fixing integrations and critical issues as they are raised. But you won’t wait for them to be raised, you’ll seek them out, too. We fix and identify technical problems with a pointed focus of providing the best customer support in the industry.

Our Commitment

We’re problem solvers that take risks and challenge cybersecurity’s status quo. It’s simple : we can’t accomplish our mission without diverse teams innovating, together.

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

title: FONOAUDIOLOGO
description:
Job description

Há 86 anos, a Fundação José Silveira mantém o olhar voltado para o futuro, reinventando suas práticas em um mundo imprevisível, sem perder de vista suas raízes sólidas naquilo que é a origem do propósito: cuidar da saúde e melhorar a qualidade de vida das pessoas.

Com isso, buscamos pessoas conectadas ao novo que venham contribuir com o constante crescimento e a perpetuação do nosso legado.

Junte-se ao nosso propósito!

Main responsibilities

  • Realizar atendimento fonoaudiológico à beira do leito em todas as unidades do hospital, com enfoque em disfagia, linguagem, voz e motricidade orofacial;
  • Auxiliar a elaboração do Manual Administrativo Técnico, a fim de normatizar o funcionamento do serviço, suas rotinas e ações assistenciais;
  • Apoiar na implementação dos kits de alimentação para avaliação, em conjunto com a nutrição, a fim de favorecer a rotina do serviço e a evolução do paciente, diminuindo o tempo de intervalo para realizada das avaliações e introdução de via oral dos mesmos, acelerando o processo de desmame de via alternativa de alimentação, com a finalidade de favorecer a redução de custos com a dieta enteral e com a desospitalização do paciente;
  • Participar da passagem de plantão do serviço, onde são discutidos os casos dos pacientes, assegurando a resolução e condução dos mesmos de forma multidisciplinar e garantindo a uniformidade das condutas;
  • Preencher as planilhas de mapas de paciente em atendimento, sendo preenchidos diariamente, a fim de fazer o controle de atendimentos e quantidade de pacientes em cada unidade, onde também são registrados todas as informações sobre quadro clínico do paciente, assim como estabelecidas e registradas condutas e observações para cada condução do caso;
  • Realizar a evolução fonoaudiológica no sistema, com o objetivo de otimizar a rotina do serviço e comunicação entre a equipe multidisciplinar;
  • Colaborar junto à nutrição e enfermagem da terapia nutricional na construção da Cartilha da Nutrição Enteral, a fim de realizar educação em saúde nas unidades, através do treinamento da equipe sobre desmame via alternativa de alimentação e introdução de via oral de forma segura e eficaz;
  • Dar suporte junto a nutrição e enfermagem da terapia nutricional nos treinamentos da EMTN, a fim de realizar educação em saúde nas unidades, através do treinamento da equipe sobre desmame via alternativa de alimentação e introdução de via oral de forma segura e eficaz.

Foi no ano de 1549, quando Tomé de Sousa ocupava o posto de governador-geral do Brasil, que foi construída uma casa de taipa e palha, no Centro Histórico de Salvador, que por cerca de 200 anos abrigou o Hospital de Caridade, primeiro hospital do Estado da Bahia, sendo o único a prestar assistência aos baianos na época.

About Us

Pointsville is an end-to-end alternative asset factory, offering solutions that bridge the gap between emerging digital financial technologies and traditional asset classes. Overview

We’re looking for a hands‑on security leader who can build, manage, and scale Pointsville’s security and compliance programs. This role is ideal for someone capable of designing enterprise‑grade security programs, engineering security tools, and embedding best practices into fast‑moving development environments.

What You’ll Do

Security Strategy, Leadership & Program Development

  • Build and lead Pointsville’s global security and compliance function from the ground up.
  • Develop and implement the company‑wide security strategy, policies, and frameworks aligned with business and regulatory goals.
  • Conduct organization‑wide risk assessments, vulnerability scans, and incident response exercises.
  • Drive security awareness and training programs to strengthen company‑wide accountability.
  • Collaborate with executive leadership to ensure security goals align with organizational priorities.

Technical Security Engineering

  • Lead the design and development of advanced security testing and monitoring platforms, including distributed fuzzing systems and validation frameworks.
  • Conduct secure architecture reviews and threat modeling for infrastructure, APIs, smart contracts, and cloud‑native services.
  • Integrate Secure SDLC practices into CI / CD pipelines—automating vulnerability discovery, testing, and compliance reporting.
  • Perform deep‑dive analysis of vulnerabilities, exploits, and mitigations across web, mobile, and blockchain systems.
  • Partner with Engineering and DevOps to ensure secure‑by‑design implementation in infrastructure‑as‑code and deployments.

Cloud, Infrastructure & Data Protection

  • Oversee cloud security architecture (AWS preferred), including network segmentation, IAM, and continuous monitoring.
  • Manage VPNs, multi‑region access, and secret management tools (Vault, KMS, etc.).
  • Ensure data privacy and protection measures are embedded in all systems and products.
  • Lead investigations, containment, and response in the event of security incidents or data breaches.

Compliance, Risk & Governance

  • Develop and maintain security compliance frameworks such as SOC 2, ISO 27001, PCI DSS, GDPR, and CCPA.
  • Prepare and manage internal and external audits and certifications.
  • Identify, document, and mitigate enterprise security and compliance risks.
  • Establish a “privacy by design” and “security by default” culture in collaboration with legal and product teams.

Communication & Collaboration

  • Serve as the main point of contact for all internal and external security and compliance matters.
  • Partner cross‑functionally with Product, Engineering, and Operations to align security controls with business needs.
  • Deliver clear reporting and recommendations to leadership on security posture, incidents, and ongoing improvements.

Qualifications & Experience

  • 7+ years of hands‑on experience in security engineering, product security, or infrastructure security roles.
  • Proven track record designing and deploying security tools and frameworks at scale.
  • Deep understanding of cryptography, secure protocols, and key management systems.
  • Expertise in AWS, Docker / Kubernetes, and large‑scale distributed systems.
  • Strong knowledge of application security (OWASP, STRIDE, TARA) and vulnerability mitigation.
  • Proficiency in one or more system languages (Java, C, C++, Rust, Go) and one scripting language (Python, Shell).
  • Experience with blockchain and smart contract security preferred.
  • Demonstrated ability to automate security controls, conduct penetration testing, and perform design reviews.
  • Strong communication and leadership skills, with experience mentoring engineers and influencing cross‑functional teams.

We are committed to providing equal opportunity for qualified applicants to contract positions, regardless of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or veteran status. This is a contract opportunity, not a direct employment role.

Gestão de produtos financeiros estratégicos, com foco em meios de pagamentos.

Responsável por criar e manter o roadmap dos produtos e soluções de meios de pagamento, alinhando-o com a estratégia da empresa e com as necessidades do mercado.

Gerir o ciclo de vida do produto, atuando em todas as fases : concepção, desenvolvimento, lançamento, crescimento, maturidade e encerramento.

Apoiar a definição de pricing, go-to-market e posicionamento dos produtos, em parceria com as áreas de marketing e comercial.

Definir e acompanhar métricas de produto e análise de dados para tomada de decisão baseada em evidências.

Garantir conformidade com regulamentações do BACEN e demais órgãos reguladores.

Atuar na integração de APIs e novos parceiros para ampliar a oferta de serviços.

Realizar benchmarking, acompanhando tendências de mercado e a concorrência para propor a criação e melhorias.

Responsável por liderar times multidisciplinares, como no entendimento das dificuldades, definição das estratégias e valor entregue dos produtos e priorização.

Responsável por fazer a ponte entre negócios, tecnologia e design. buscando o equilíbrio para o desenvolvimento de produtos digitais.

Garantir que o Backlog do Produto seja visível, transparente e claro para todos.

Participar de homologações, validando as soluções implementadas e garantindo a entrega de valor esperada.

Conhecimento de metodologias ágeis : Scrum, Kanban, Lean, SAFe.

Experiência com ferramentas de gestão de produto / projetos : Jira, Miro, Confluence.

Conhecimento em tecnologia : Familiaridade com integrações bancárias, gateways e APIs.

Análise de dados e métricas de produto : Habilidade analítica para interpretar métricas, identificar oportunidades e direcionar melhorias nos produtos digitais (Google Analytics, Hotjar, Amplitude, Power BI etc.)

title: Escalation Manager
description:
Our Mission

At Palo Alto Networks® everything starts and ends with our mission :

Being the cybersecurity partner of choice, protecting our digital way of life.

Our vision is a world where each day is safer and more secure than the one before. We are a company built on the foundation of challenging and disrupting the way things are done, and we’re looking for innovators who are as committed to shaping the future of cybersecurity as we are.

Who We Are

This role is remote, but distance is no barrier to impact. Our hybrid teams collaborate across geographies to solve big problems, stay close to our customers, and grow together. You will be part of a culture that values trust, accountability, and shared success where your work truly matters.

Job Description

Your Career

The Escalation Manager position is a strategic, high-visibility role that provides the highest level of escalation for customer issues that are jeopardizing the Palo Alto Networks business relationship and / or sales opportunities with key customers.

The Escalation Manager will lead and manage the resolution of customers' critical issues by forming and leading an interdepartmental, cross-functional, and geographically dispersed Palo Alto Networks virtual team which are formed based on the customer and escalation needs.

In leading the virtual team, the escalations Manager will liaise with and work across various Palo Alto Networks functional organizations and business units, and with all levels of the company; from Support, Sales, Product management, and development engineers to management and corporate executives.

Your Impact

Escalation Leadership

Ownership for driving progress and resolution of customers' critical issues

Drive clear intake, scope, priority, exit criteria and end to end process to achieve streamlined escalation resolution

Drive global consistency across portfolio and customers

Maintain and improve procedures for customer and field personnel for escalation handling

Handle direct customer leadership and technical audiences as appropriate

Expedite Resolution

Engage and lead cross-functional and geographically dispersed teams in the development and execution of action plans to address critical situations

Strong ability to influence and be effective at assigning tasks and responsibilities to successfully achieve all key objectives of the critical account and issues

Clear accountability on relevant owners on driving to target service-level Objectives(SLO) and intermediate milestones leading up to it

Interlock with Executive Sponsors to help resolve roadblocks in a timely manner

Communication and Reporting

Effectively communicate critical issue status to executive staff, sales, support, product teams and other invested parties

Effective use of dashboards and keen understanding of how to use data to help deliver the outcomes needed and track progress towards SLO

Set clear customer expectations and ensure timely updates on troubleshooting and resolution action plans for internal and customer facing communications

Risk Management

Make informed decisions on elevating urgency and apply relevant focus to solve for a situation with right governance, guardrails and reviews in place

A “whatever it takes” customer-first attitude and a willingness to go the extra mile to foster customer success

Demonstrate strong judgment in risk management and problem mitigation, as well as making timely decisions from both business and technical perspectives

Retrospective and Preventive Measures

Retrospectives and PostMortem to help improve the process / system / product

Identify systemic and pervasive issues related to products and / or processes and drive actions to prevent future problems

Recognitions and reporting on problem areas which will give insight to the magnitude of the issue through the amount of cases or number of customers impacted or related to these areas

Understanding of techniques to predict risks using data and AI models and systematic approach to address

Co-create and pilot proactive programs to reduce likelihood of customer and field escalations

Qualifications

Your Experience

Fully fluent in Portuguese, English, and Spanish both written and verbal

Customer Experience

10+ years of customer-facing sales and / or service delivery roles

Past experience as Escalations Engineer / Manager, Technical Account Management, Engineering Management, Customer Support Management, or similar roles desired

Customer centric attitude and focus on providing best-in-class service for customers and collaborators

Program / Project management

Manage critical issues in a cross-functional environment that includes working with support, customer success, professional services, sales, customers, and partners to resolve complex and critical issues

Ability to multitask and prioritize with a goal of driving issues to closure on behalf of the customer

Familiarity with tools like Salesforce, Asana, Tableau, JIRA and experience in running and operating with the SLA / SLO / Milestones paradigm and clarity on what success and corresponding metrics looks like

Collaboration and Influence

Strong capacity for Influencing, negotiating, and delegating efforts

Ability to work in a fast-paced, challenging environment with global customers

Leadership and communication skills

Experience in being able to effectively lead and motivate a team of cross functional professionals

Expertise in communicating complex topics in a clear and concise manner to different tiers of audiences(highly technical, less technical, executives, practitioners)

Technical skills

Experience with Networking / Security Products

Knowledge of LAN / WAN technologies, encompassing general routing / switching / security for both branch and data center architectures

Ownership for driving progress and resolution of customers' critical issues

Engage and lead cross-functional and geographically dispersed teams in the development and execution of action plans to address critical situations

Effectively communicate critical issue status to executive staff, sales teams, and other invested parties

Creative thinking, adaptability, and versatility

Demonstrate strong judgment in risk management and problem mitigation, as well as making timely decisions from both business and technical perspectives

Strong ability to influence and effective at assigning tasks and responsibilities to successfully achieve all key objectives of the critical account

Identify systemic and pervasive issues related to products and / or processes and drive actions to prevent future issues

Additional Information

The Team

The Escalation Managers are part of the Global Incident and Escalation Management team which part of Global Customer Support and Service teams covering all Palo Alto offerings of cybersecurity platforms and solutions.

Team is responsible for driving expedited response, remedy, resolution, and learnings for our most critical issues. Escalation Managers(EM) team ensures focused technical leadership, effective coordination and communication, and streamlined decision-making

As Escalation Managers, each team member will be at the vanguard of our dedication to cybersecurity. Addressing the most pressing situations for our customers, you will hold a central position in solidifying our reputation as the go-to cybersecurity partner. This role demands proactivity, efficiency, an unwavering dedication to constant refinement, and a passion for customer satisfaction.

Driving continuous learnings and efficiency into the Escalation Management and Product Lifecycle is one of the key areas for the team as we continue our focus on customer experience.

Our Commitment

We’re problem solvers that take risks and challenge cybersecurity’s status quo. It’s simple : we can’t accomplish our mission without diverse teams innovating, together.

Buscamos: Analista de Processamento de Dados Sr

A Kantar Media é líder global em pesquisa de mídia. Isso inclui medição de audiência - relatando todas as visualizações em todas as plataformas, perfil do consumidor e segmentação com TGI e inteligência de publicidade detalhada. Nossa versatilidade, escala, tecnologia e experiência permitem que nossas equipes entendam o cenário de mídia em constante mudança e impulsionem o crescimento de nossos clientes.

Resumo do cargo:

Monitorar os pipelines diários de processamento de dados em um ambiente nativo da nuvem para o painel Origin no Reino Unido. Garantir que várias saídas sejam geradas conforme programado, verificar a qualidade da saída, relatar a entrega de arquivos, realizar alterações de parâmetros e testes de desempenho nos sistemas.

O que você irá fazer:

  • Instalar novas versões de software no ambiente ativo depois que elas forem aceitas pela Operação de Dados e Controle de Qualidade para uma data de instalação planejada.
  • Supervisionar a conclusão da coleta de dados e correspondência de áudio para TV e VM.
  • Monitorar o processamento de dados em todas as etapas do ciclo de produção.
  • Instalar e testar novas versões de software sob medida para garantir que o processamento seja executado de forma aceitável, agendado corretamente e produza a saída conforme o esperado.
  • Contato com as equipes de desenvolvimento e suporte de aplicativos para identificar quaisquer gargalos ou atualizações de produção que alimentarão o ciclo de atualização.
  • Gerenciar, manter e implantar clusters do Kubernetes.
  • Testar as alterações nas configurações e as alterações do sistema em servidores que não sejam de produção.

O que buscamos?

Essencial:

  • Bons conhecimentos em implantação e suporte a clusters do Azure Kubernetes System (AKS).
  • Noções básicas de administração de nuvem do Azure.
  • Bons conhecimentos em containers / Linux.
  • Licenciatura em ciências tecnológicas, engenharia, análise de dados ou similar.
  • Inglês intermediário para avançado – terá contato frequente com Londres.

  • Terraform e Helm para implantação de infraestrutura.
  • Conhecimento de ferramentas de monitoramento de sistemas como Zabbix.
  • Fluência em espanhol.

Horário de trabalho 6hs – 15hs – contrato remoto.
